channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Zelenskyy urges urgent efforts in Ukraine to start Patriot production
item.description: US President Donald Trump gave his blessing earlier this week to domestic Ukrainian production of the missiles.

item.title: Iran says strikes hit southern areas, but US denies it carried attacks
item.description: Iranian state media reported that military headquarters were hit by strikes in Bushehr province and the city of Konarak.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic plunges as US, Iran resume fighting
item.description: Brent crude holds steady despite a plunge in traffic in the critical waterway.

item.title: Gaza mourns aid worker killed by Israel who helped them see the World Cup
item.description: Israeli strike killed Mohammed al-Wahidi and three others on the eve of the Egypt vs Argentina match on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran war live: New attacks on Iran as US says talks still on
item.description: Washington official says that technical talks with Iran continue and that the US wants to pursue diplomacy.

item.title: How Strait of Hormuz dispute led to latest US-Iran cycle of fighting
item.description: Clashing interpretations of vague memorandum of understanding language on Hormuz at heart of escalation, analysts say.

item.title: US military denies involvement after explosions heard in Iran
item.description: Iranian media report loud explosions in several locations as Israeli officials say war is 'not over'.

item.title: Mexico seeks prosecutions over migrant deaths in the US
item.description: Mexico will seek state and federal prosecutions in the United States over the deaths of Mexican migrants.

item.title: Why the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve matters amid US-Iran tensions
item.description: US oil reserves hit lowest levels since 1983 amid growing tensions with Iran and global supply concerns.

item.title: Two more men plead guilty in US for deadly 2021 human-smuggling truck crash
item.description: Five Guatemalan nationals have now plead guilty in the migrant smuggling case linked to the deaths of 55 migrants.
